messages:
Ana: Quick sync — CloudHaven marketplace co-marketing. We want: listing + joint demo video + launch blog + webinar. Target launch: 2026-04-07. Who can own which pieces?
Mike: I can run partner comms and own the webinar logistics. Will pick speakers.
Harper: I’ll draft the blog and promo copy. Need benchmark numbers, hero screenshot, and a 2-line customer quote.
Liam: Product will run benchmark sweep on staging today. Expected deliverables: p50/p95 latency, cost-per-1k-tokens, demo script for integration flow, and a 16:9 hero screenshot. ETA EOD PST.
Jared: Ops will set up the inbound lead routing and marketplace asset bundle. Need final UTMs and HubSpot pipeline mapping.
Ana: Excellent. Quick checklist: 1) benchmark numbers (Liam) 2) hero screenshot & short demo clip (Liam/Jared) 3) blog draft (Harper) 4) webinar page + registration (Mike) 5) lead routing + UTMs (Jared) 6) legal signoff on partner assets (Ana).
Mike: Tentative webinar slot: 2026-04-07 10am PT, 45m (30m demo + 10m QA + 5m buffer). @Harper do you want to run a partner co-host intro?
Harper: Yep. I’ll write a short 5-line opener and the CTA copy for registration.
Liam: Posting benchmark snippet here so you can quote in the blog: 
```
Model: redwood-optimized-3B
Seq: 512
p50 latency: 38ms/token
p95 latency: 112ms/token
Estimated cost: $0.12 / 1k tokens (after batch & cache)
```
Use "redwood-optimized-3B" shorthand.
Ana: Copy that. Harper — use the p50/p95 + cost line in the top paragraph and link to our benchmark repo. Keep language non-technical for marketing.
Jared: For lead routing, push everything with utm_source=cloudhaven and campaign=rh-cloudhaven-apr2026. HubSpot rule (example):
```
if utm_source == 'cloudhaven':
  set hubspot_owner = 'integration_sales_team'
  set lead_queue = 'marketplace_inbound'
  add_tag = 'co-marketing/cloudhaven'
  webhook -> https://hooks.redwood-internal.com/hubspot/create
```
I'll implement and share test form.
Mike: Also agree we should create a small inbound SLA: 24h first-touch from AE for MQLs from the webinar. Jared can you confirm routing works with that?
Jared: Yes — will add a shuffle to assign to oncall AE if primary doesn't accept in 24h.
Ana: Deadlines: benchmarks & screenshots by EOD today; blog first draft by Wed EOD; webinar registration page live by Fri; final assets to partner (CloudHaven) by Mon 2026-03-30.
Harper: I’ll post first draft in #marketing-drafts and ping for feedback.
Mike: I’ll schedule a rehearsal on 2026-04-03 10am PT.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled — rehearsal calendar invite created for 2026-04-03 10:00 PT.
Ana: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here or DM. :thumbsup:
